extDescription.message: Automatically resets YouTube playback speed to 1.0x when a video matches your conditions.

keywordsHelp.message: Play at normal speed when the title or channel includes any of the keywords below.

excludeKeywordsHelp.message: Do not change playback speed when the title or channel includes any of the excluded keywords below.

enableOfficialArtistLabel.message: Normalize when the Official Artist badge is present

enableOfficialArtistHelp.message: Play at normal speed when the Official Artist badge appears next to the channel name.

enableDescriptionMusicLabel.message: Normalize when a Music section is present

enableDescriptionMusicHelp.message: Play at normal speed when the description includes a Music section.

searchInChannelHelp.message: Also match keywords and excluded keywords in the channel name.

enableTitlePatternHelp.message: Play at normal speed when the title matches patterns like Artist - Song or Artist 'Song', and similar formats.

confirmDeleteAllKeywords.message: If you delete all keywords, no videos will be normalized. Delete them?
